svg.aria-label: CT4 Q4: Board-based backtracking algorithm and 4-Queens solution

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: CT4 Q4: Board-based backtracking algorithm and 4-Queens solution

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: Backtracking algorithm — instruction-style, follows the C++ code

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: 1. Read n; fill board[n][n] with 0s.
2. In isSafe(row, col), check the same column above:
inspect board[i][col] for i = 0..row−1; a 1 means false.
3. Scan upper-right from i = row−1, j = col+1.
While i ≥ 0 and j < n, check each cell; a 1 means false.
Otherwise move up-right: i ← i−1, j ← j+1.
4. Scan upper-left from i = row−1, j = col−1.
While i ≥ 0 and j ≥ 0, check each cell; a 1 means false.
Otherwise move up-left: i ← i−1, j ← j−1.
If all three scans are clear, return true.
5. In solve(row), if row == n, return true.
6. Try each col = 0..n−1 in this row.
If isSafe(row, col) is false, try the next column.
Otherwise place queen: board[row][col] ← 1.
Call solve(row + 1); if true, return true.
If it fails, undo: board[row][col] ← 0; continue.
7. If no column works, return false.
8. Call solve(0); print board if true, else "No solution".

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: Illustrative first-solution run for n = 4

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: Columns 0..3: [0,2] fails; [0,3,1] fails;
then [1,3,0,2] is the first solution.

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: q[row] = column
row 0 → 1
row 1 → 3
row 2 → 0
row 3 → 2
return true

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: First solution: [1, 3, 0, 2]

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: Invariant: rows 0..row−1 already hold one mutually nonattacking queen; isSafe checks every attack direction above.
Worst-case time O(n·n!); board storage Θ(n²), plus Θ(n) recursion-stack space.

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: Board coordinates are zero-based
